name: Hard cut on the one
lesson:
## Sometimes the best mix is no mix

B runs silent with its fader down for 32 bars; on the first beat of bar 33 you swap both faders inside a quarter beat. The cut works only if bar 33 is a phrase boundary in both tracks, so cue B to its drop.

Big-room and techno DJs cut more than they blend. The skill is the count, not the hands.

tracks.cue: A on the arpeggio riff section.
Cue B on the first beat of its drop, not its intro. Both faders swap inside a quarter beat on bar 33; the cut only works because both tracks are on a phrase boundary.
Alternative B: cue on the first beat of the acid bassline entry.
